subject: Suspicious Activity Detected

attachment.name: Security_Alert.pdf
attachment.content: SUSPICIOUS CONTENT: This 'security report' asks you to call a phone number and provide your account PIN, Social Security Number, and online banking password. Real banks never request sensitive information this way.

subject: Overdue Invoice #QB-2024-0891
body: Your payment is overdue. Please see the attached invoice for immediate payment.

attachment.name: Invoice_QB-2024-0891.pdf
attachment.content: SUSPICIOUS CONTENT: This fake invoice contains a QR code that leads to a payment site asking for credit card information. The invoice has spelling errors and an unusual payment method request. Always verify invoices through official channels.

subject: Document requires your signature
